title: The Kronecker Symbol: Extending Jacobi to All Integers
description: Defines the Kronecker symbol extending the Jacobi symbol to even moduli, negative integers, and zero. Proves values at special arguments, agreement with Jacobi for odd positive moduli, and states multiplicativity and generalized quadratic reciprocity.

meta.author: Kronecker (1885); formalized here
meta.assumptions: 2 axioms: kronecker_mul_right (multiplicativity), kronecker_reciprocity (generalized QR). No sorries.

overview.historicalContext: Leopold Kronecker extended the Jacobi symbol in 1885 to handle all integer arguments, creating a symbol fundamental to algebraic number theory, Dirichlet L-functions, and modular forms.
overview.problemStatement: Define the Kronecker symbol (a/n) for all integers a,n and prove its basic properties.
overview.text: Formalizes the Kronecker symbol extension of the Jacobi symbol.
overview.proofStrategy: Formalizes the Kronecker symbol extension of the Jacobi symbol.

conclusion.summary: The Kronecker symbol provides a uniform framework for quadratic characters over all integers.
conclusion.implications: The Kronecker symbol provides a uniform framework for quadratic characters over all integers.

crossReferences.description: Extends the Jacobi symbol formalization to the Kronecker symbol for all integers
